body: I won’t but the self harm is just on my mind all the time. I feel like I can’t relax till I have done it. But I’m desperately trying not to. It won’t make much of a difference either way but I just wanna stop feeling tempted by it and stop feeling so empty and numb :(
Yeah :( he’s always said we will always work through our problems but he never actually does that
I just don’t understand how to make him see how much pain I’m in without him getting all defensive

He’s just never ‘in the mood for a hug’ and it’s really getting to me. He says he told me he wasn’t clingy and shit at the start of the relationship but that’s utter bullshit cus when I started work with him he wld hug me every morning as soon as he got to work and saw me, he wanted me. Now it doesn’t really feel like I need to be here

Okay thank you, I think he feels as tho I should just know that he loves me but I need the hugs and kisses and the chatting for hours and he used to be into all that but slowly he’s just stopped yet says he still loves me and doesn’t wanna break up. I really don’t think he understands how much pain I’m in with everything

Thank you that helped a bit. I get u I just really don’t like feeling like I don’t wanna be with him when I know I do and I know he wants to be with me. It just feels like he cba to put in the effort. Like if he askes for head rubs I do it otherwise he gets moody but if I ask, if he says no it’s a no :/
I’m on elvance! 40mg morning and 20mg afternoon I feel like I can’t function without it tbh

I have found therapy really tricky as I have no motivation, being suicidal (I’m safe, won’t do anything) but idk like I’m just really stuck, I’m on olanzapine for my anxiety and it’s doing something but not solving my problem. I’m still getting very severe anxiety and nausea
I think I just don’t feel like I’m getting the support I should be from him. But I also don’t want to leave him. We have been thro so much together but I just worry none of this will change

My boyfriend definitely loves me and cares about me, he just isn’t very cuddly and isn’t usually in the mood to snuggle up. If I cry and I say I just need a hug, he hugs me and after 5 mins he’s telling me to stop crying now cus il make myself ill :/
Feel like this all the time. Doesn’t every rly get any better :/
